components.purpose: Full-width opening banner with heading, description, and two CTA buttons over a gradient or background image (placed at top, under the menu).
Customer logos row as social proof directly under the opening banner.
Features grid with screenshots: cards with eyebrow, title, description and a graphic, suited to product screenshots. FeatureGrid was rejected because it is icon-based, not screenshot-based.
Three key stats as a single row of value-and-label tiles under a centered heading. CompanyStats was rejected because it needs a section title and background image.
One featured customer quote with name, title, quote and image. The singular component fits one quote; Testimonials would show a list.
Final contact form with heading, description, submit messages, and office address, phone and email. NewsletterSignup was rejected because it is email-only, and CTABanner has no form.
